access_drivers.description: Change the API access control scheme. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#access_drivers = [ "polkit" ]).

admin_keepalive_count.description: Admin keepalive count. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#admin_keepalive_count = 5).

admin_keepalive_interval.description: Admin keepalive interval in seconds. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#admin_keepalive_interval = 5).

admin_keepalive_required.description: Admin keepalive required (deprecated). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#admin_keepalive_required = 1).

admin_max_client_requests.description: Limit on concurrent requests from a single admin client connection. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#admin_max_client_requests = 5).

admin_max_clients.description: The maximum number of concurrent admin client connections. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#admin_max_clients = 5).

admin_max_queued_clients.description: The maximum length of queue of admin connections. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#admin_max_queued_clients = 5).

admin_max_workers.description: The maximum limit sets the number of admin workers. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#admin_max_workers = 5).

admin_min_workers.description: The minimum limit sets the number of admin workers to start up initially. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#admin_min_workers = 1).

audit_level.description: Usage of the auditing subsystem. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#audit_level = 2).

audit_logging.description: Send audit messages via libvirt logging infrastructure. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#audit_logging = 1).

auth_tcp.description: Change the authentication scheme for TCP sockets. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#auth_tcp = "sasl").

auth_tls.description: Change the authentication scheme for TLS sockets. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#auth_tls = "none").

auth_unix_ro.description: Set an authentication scheme for UNIX read-only sockets. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#auth_unix_ro = "polkit").

auth_unix_rw.description: Set an authentication scheme for UNIX read-write sockets. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#auth_unix_rw = "polkit").

ca_file.description: Override the default CA certificate path. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#ca_file = "/etc/pki/CA/cacert.pem").

cert_file.description: Override the default server certificate file path. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#cert_file = "/etc/pki/libvirt/servercert.pem").

cert_files.description: Override the default server certificate file path(s). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#cert_files = ["/etc/pki/libvirt/servercert-0.pem", "/etc/pki/libvirt/servercert-1.pem"]).

crl_file.description: Specify a certificate revocation list. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#crl_file = "/etc/pki/CA/crl.pem").

host_uuid.description: UUID of the host. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#host_uuid = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000").

host_uuid_source.description: Source of the host UUID. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#host_uuid_source = "smbios").

keepalive_count.description: Keepalive count. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#keepalive_count = 5).

keepalive_interval.description: Keepalive interval in seconds. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#keepalive_interval = 5).

keepalive_required.description: Keepalive required (deprecated). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#keepalive_required = 1).

key_file.description: Override the default server key file path. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#key_file = "/etc/pki/libvirt/private/serverkey.pem").

key_files.description: Override the default server key file path(s). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#key_files = ["/etc/pki/libvirt/private/serverkey-0.pem", "/etc/pki/libvirt/private/serverkey-1.pem"]).

listen_addr.description: Override the default configuration which binds to all network interfaces. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#listen_addr = "192.168.0.1").

listen_tcp.description: Listen for unencrypted TCP connections on the public TCP/IP port. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#listen_tcp = 1).

listen_tls.description: Flag listening for secure TLS connections on the public TCP/IP port. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#listen_tls = 0).

log_filters.description: Logging filters. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#log_filters="1:qemu 1:libvirt 4:object 4:json 4:event 1:util").

log_level.description: Logging level: 4 errors, 3 warnings, 2 information, 1 debug. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#log_level = 3).

log_outputs.description: Logging outputs. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#log_outputs="3:syslog:virtproxyd").

max_anonymous_clients.description: The maximum length of queue of accepted but not yet authenticated clients. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#max_anonymous_clients = 20).

max_client_requests.description: Limit on concurrent requests from a single client connection. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#max_client_requests = 5).

max_clients.description: The maximum number of concurrent client connections to allow over all sockets combined. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#max_clients = 5000).

max_queued_clients.description: The maximum length of queue of connections waiting to be accepted by the daemon. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#max_queued_clients = 1000).

max_workers.description: The maximum limit sets the number of workers. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#max_workers = 20).

min_workers.description: The minimum limit sets the number of workers to start up initially. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#min_workers = 5).

ovs_timeout.description: Timeout for openvswitch calls. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#ovs_timeout = 5).

prio_workers.description: The number of priority workers. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#prio_workers = 5).

sasl_allowed_username_list.description: An access control list of allowed SASL usernames. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#sasl_allowed_username_list = ["joe@EXAMPLE.COM", "fred@EXAMPLE.COM" ]).

tcp_min_ssf.description: Enforce a minimum SSF value for TCP sockets. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#tcp_min_ssf = 112).

tcp_port.description: Override the port for accepting insecure TCP connections. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#tcp_port = "16509").

tls_allowed_dn_list.description: An access control list of allowed x509 Distinguished Names. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#tls_allowed_dn_list = ["DN1", "DN2"]).

tls_no_sanity_certificate.description: Flag to disable verification of our own server certificates. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#tls_no_sanity_certificate = 1).

tls_no_verify_certificate.description: Flag to disable verification of client certificates. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#tls_no_verify_certificate = 1).

tls_port.description: Override the port for accepting secure TLS connections. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#tls_port = "16514").

tls_priority.description: Override the compile time default TLS priority string. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#tls_priority="NORMAL").

unix_sock_admin_perms.description: Set the UNIX socket permissions for the admin interface socket. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#unix_sock_admin_perms = "0700").

unix_sock_dir.description: Set the name of the directory in which sockets will be found/created. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#unix_sock_dir = "/run/libvirt").

unix_sock_group.description: Set the UNIX domain socket group ownership. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#unix_sock_group = "libvirt").

unix_sock_ro_perms.description: Set the UNIX socket permissions for the R/O socket. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#unix_sock_ro_perms = "0777").

unix_sock_rw_perms.description: Set the UNIX socket permissions for the R/W socket. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#unix_sock_rw_perms = "0770").
